scientific_question: Does rank-weighted stochastic all-role decoding improve all six measured-Ugi role-distribution distances over the frozen amine-semantic joint-support decoder at the completed 256-program preflight scale?
nonclaims: This is a seed-0 train-fold-only diagnostic over an already completed 256-program preflight, not a full-budget or across-training-seed model claim.
The reassessment performs no training, generation, repair, retry, routing, oracle calls or candidate selection.
The panel reports directional consistency without a confidence interval or significance claim.
C2ST is secondary and does not determine the panel classification.
A favorable role panel cannot override any validity, exact-L1, unique-yield or effective-count gate.
